name: public
_why: TypeScript v6.0.3 is the large repo (about 70k files, the last release written in TypeScript; FriedLiver's index bench uses the same tag). Edits (S4/S5) need a fast, real test run, so they use nestjs/nest, a large NestJS monorepo.

scenarios.title: Cold start overview
scenarios.prompt: Give me an overview of this project's architecture.

scenarios.title: Find a function
scenarios.prompt: Where is `isTypeAssignableTo` defined and what calls it?

scenarios.title: Targeted edit + test
scenarios.prompt: In packages/common/utils/shared.utils.ts, change `stripEndSlash` so it removes every trailing slash, not just one (for example '/cats///' becomes '/cats'). Update its test in packages/common/test/utils/shared.utils.spec.ts to cover this.

scenarios.title: Follow-up edge case
scenarios.prompt: Now also handle a path made only of slashes, like '/' or '///': stripEndSlash must return '/' for it, not an empty string. Update the test too.

scenarios.title: Explain a module
scenarios.prompt: Explain how the compiler turns a .ts file into emitted JavaScript: which parts run, in which order, and where each lives.

scenarios.title: Web/doc lookup
scenarios.prompt: Use your web fetch or browser tool to read https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html and tell me the number of the HTTP status code named "Misdirected Request".
